## Summary / 变更说明

Describe the problem and the solution. Keep the change focused.

请说明问题与解决方案，并保持改动范围集中。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] I tested the affected desktop and/or phone flow. / 已验证受影响的电脑端或手机端流程。
- [ ] I updated the Chinese and English documentation when behavior changed. / 行为变化时已同步更新中英文文档。

## Safety / 安全

- [ ] The change does not patch DSH core or build artifacts. / 改动没有修改 DSH 内核或构建产物。
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and fixtures contain no pairing URL, token, cookie, API key, or private workspace data. / 日志、截图与测试数据不含配对链接、Token、Cookie、API Key 或私人工作区数据。
- [ ] New network downloads have a pinned source and integrity check. / 新增网络下载具有固定来源与完整性校验。
